measurement.title: Small Speaker - Very Big Low End

notes:
Small Speaker. Very Big Low End.

This one wasn’t really about how loud the demonstration was, but about what was happening at the bottom of the spectrum.

During a demonstration by D’Von Audio, SPL Reference captured a remarkably extended and controlled low-frequency response from a relatively compact **pre-production loudspeaker.

In the conditions of this demonstration, the measured response extended to around 24 Hz, remaining impressively linear— an unexpected result from a speaker of this size.

More interesting than sheer bass quantity was the way the system managed the low end dynamically: depth, control and extension without the bass simply dominating the presentation.

A good reminder of why at DSR we like to put measurements alongside listening impressions: sometimes what surprises the ears becomes even more interesting when you can see what is happening.
